brief:
US Vice President JD Vance told reporters he is "not endorsing" Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Middle East Eye reported. The statement came days before Israeli parliamentary elections are set to take place.

Vance's remarks signal a departure from the Trump administration's previous support for Netanyahu's government, though the vice president stopped short of backing an alternative candidate or party ahead of the vote.
dek: Vance says he is 'not endorsing' Netanyahu in Israeli election US Vice President JD Vance told reporters that he is "not endorsing" Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu just days before Israeli parliamentary elections are set to take place.
title: Vance says he is not endorsing Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections
